name: Context Compression & Active Invariant Projection Evaluation

conditions.name: Full Verified Context (Phase 47 Control)
conditions.description: Model receives complete verified semantic state: objective, full interface contracts, state assertions, historical observations, dependency outputs, and repository facts.

conditions.name: Static Relevance Filter
conditions.description: Model receives deterministically filtered state: only contracts and assertions directly referenced by the active sub-task, immediate dependency outputs, current objective, and workspace facts.

conditions.name: Active Invariant Projection
conditions.description: Model receives compact deterministic invariant projection: CURRENT_OBJECTIVE, REQUIRED_INPUT_CONTRACT, REQUIRED_OUTPUT_CONTRACT, ACTIVE_INVARIANTS, RECENT_VERIFIED_STATE, UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENCIES, CURRENT_WORKSPACE_FACTS.

conditions.name: Active Projection + Budgeted Context (4096B)
conditions.description: Same as Condition C with strict MAX_SEMANTIC_CONTEXT_BYTES = 4096 budget. Deterministic priority-based whole-item omission (P0-P6), never mid-item truncation, tracking all omitted items.

relevanceRules.name: Boundary Definition
relevanceRules.description: Defines input/output boundary of active sub-task

relevanceRules.name: Dependency Output
relevanceRules.description: Verified output from immediate dependency sub-task

relevanceRules.name: Unresolved Invariant
relevanceRules.description: Unresolved invariant required by active sub-task

relevanceRules.name: Workspace State
relevanceRules.description: Describes current workspace state relevant to active objective

relevanceRules.name: Unresolved Failure
relevanceRules.description: Represents recent failure that remains unresolved

priorityOrder.description: Active sub-task objective and target scope
Input and output typed interface contracts
Unresolved or failed state assertions requiring repair
Verified outputs produced by immediate predecessor sub-tasks
Verified file paths, module exports, and test fixtures
Most recent clean-room test and tool observations
Historical sub-task logs and non-immediate execution records

failureTaxonomy.name: Present and Authoritative
failureTaxonomy.description: Required semantic information was present, fresh, and authoritative, but model failed to produce correct code

failureTaxonomy.name: Present but Stale
failureTaxonomy.description: Semantic item was present in context but had become stale due to intervening mutation

failureTaxonomy.name: Present but Contradicted
failureTaxonomy.description: Semantic items in context contained contradictory assertions or contracts

failureTaxonomy.name: Omitted by Projection
failureTaxonomy.description: Required semantic item was omitted due to budget constraint or relevance filter

failureTaxonomy.name: Present but Unused
failureTaxonomy.description: Correct contract/assertion was available in compact form but ignored during code synthesis

failureTaxonomy.name: Not Represented by Anchor
failureTaxonomy.description: Required semantic constraint was not captured by existing interface contracts or assertions

failureTaxonomy.name: Local Passed Global Failed
failureTaxonomy.description: All local sub-task invariants verified but global multi-component interaction failed due to complex AST recursion
